name: Invalid Number of Possibilities for Entanglement or Superposition
hint: A quantum entanglement or superposition needs at least one possible outcome. A value below 1 becomes no possibilities during execution and can leave the quantum state unusable.
instruction: Set the number of possibilities to at least 1, and validate dynamic inputs before starting an entanglement or superposition.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when superposition started :: events hat #5c068c
forever
turn right (15) degrees
wait (0.1) seconds
end

when green flag clicked
superpose [position v] possibilities: (0) :: #5c068c
